create_object_detection_evaluator: create an ObjectDetectionEvaluator with categories and matching IOU threshold to evaluate object detection results
add_ground_truth_image_info: add ground truth boxes and class labels for a single image to the ObjectDetectionEvaluator
add_detected_image_info: add detected boxes, scores, and class labels for a single image to the ObjectDetectionEvaluator
evaluate_detection_metrics: evaluate detection results and return mAP, precision, recall, and CorLoc metrics as a dictionary
create_pascal_detection_evaluator: create a PascalDetectionEvaluator to compute PASCAL VOC style mAP metrics for object detection
